newsitem.title: USA: U.S. weekly rice cash market summary -- USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. weekly rice cash market summary -- USDA.

text.p: In the South, rice prices were steady to instances $1.00 lower in the week ended Sept. 7. Long grain milled rice prices were selling mostly at $20.50 per cwt with sources reporting discounts of up to $1.00, Medium grain mostly $19.50-$20.00, Second heads were steady at $13.50-$14.00. Brewers were steady trading mostly at $13.00. Rice by-products were higher with bran selling steady to $10.00 higher, millfeed was mostly steady to $5.00 higher.
In California, rice prices were steady with Medium grain selling mostly at $20.00-$20.50. Rice bran was steady to $2.00 higher for spot sales.
California rice ship loadings: At the Port of Sacramento there were no ship loadings for the week ending September 7, 1996.

Inspections of California rice for export: There were no inspections for the week ending September 7, 1996. The yearly total since October 1, 1995 is 7,606,520 cwt compared to 6,651,444 cwt a year ago.
